name: The Pasteur Protocol
description: Dr. Beaumont has traced a radiation-laced plague moving through surviving communities to a pre-war pharmaceutical laboratory near what used to be Rue de Rivoli. Someone synthesized it. Someone released it deliberately.

stages.name: Reach the Rue de Rivoli Laboratory
stages.description: Navigate the Paris ruins to the pre-war pharmaceutical laboratory near what was once Rue de Rivoli. Radiation levels in the area are elevated.

stages.name: Investigate the Laboratory
stages.description: Search the abandoned pharmaceutical lab for evidence of the plague's synthesis. Dr. Beaumont needs production records, culture logs, and any documentation of who authorized the work.

stages.name: Identify the Pathogen Origin
stages.description: The production logs point to a specific project designation. Cross-reference with Dr. Beaumont's research notes to identify who authorized the synthesis.

stages.name: Confront the Source
stages.description: The origin points to someone still operating in the Paris ruins. Find them and neutralize the remaining plague stockpile.
